games.name: The Glass Bridge
games.desc:
ⓘ THIS GAME IS FINISHED AND WILL (most likely) NOT RECEIVE ANY MORE OFFICIAL UPDATES!

Step into a faithful recreation of the iconic Glass Bridge from Netflix's Squid Game. Test your luck and courage as you race to cross before the 5-minute timer runs out!

Earn 10 points for discovering a safe tile first and 1000 points for reaching the other side. Spend points on abilities like Push or Glass Checker, and climb onto global leaderboards!
